description:
Program Overview

MSCA Doctoral Networks are prestigious Horizon Europe funded doctoral training programmes that implement international, intersectoral doctoral training networks. These networks bring together universities, research institutions, and businesses from across Europe to train next-generation researchers in engineering fields.

Funding & Benefits

  • Living Allowance: €4,250 per month (adjusted by country coefficient) for 3-4 years
  • Mobility Allowance: €710 per month for 3-4 years
  • Family Allowance: €660 per month (if applicable) for 3-4 years
  • Research Costs: €1,000+ per month for research expenses
  • Total Value: Approximately €150,000 - €200,000 per researcher

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Open to researchers from anywhere in the world
  • Mobility Rule: Must not have resided or carried out main activity in the country of the host organization for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately before the recruitment date
  • Experience: Early-stage researchers (with less than 4 years full-time research experience)
  • Field: Engineering, Computer Science, or related disciplines

Application Process

  1. Find network and position.
  2. Submit application to network.
  3. Network selection process.
  4. EU evaluation.
  5. Recruitment decision.
  6. Start PhD program.

Key Engineering Networks

  • Power Systems: Smart grids, renewable energy integration, power electronics
  • Robotics: Industrial robotics, medical robotics, autonomous systems
  • Microelectronics: Semiconductor devices, integrated circuits, sensors
  • Biomedical Engineering: Medical devices, biomechanics, biomaterials
  • Control Systems: Advanced control, automation, process optimization

Timeline & Deadlines

StageDate
Call Opens26 May 2027
Application Deadline23 November 2027
Evaluation PeriodDecember 2027 - March 2028
Selection NotificationApril-May 2028
Program StartSeptember 2028

Official Link

https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/

Important Notes

  • International experience: train in multiple European countries with secondments to industry partners.
  • Direct partnerships with leading engineering companies.
  • Generous funding covering living, research, and mobility costs.
  • Search the MSCA Doctoral Networks portal for positions matching your engineering specialization.

MSCA 2026 rates: doctoral candidates receive a living allowance of €4,010 per month plus a mobility allowance of €710 per month (€660 family top-up where eligible), adjusted by the national correction coefficient.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 23 November 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
